intent: Close the campaign post-attestation alias seam. The exact routed and direct provider boundaries detach one canonical LLMResponse, including nested usage and tool-call values, immediately after exact provider/model attestation and before any success telemetry await or downstream consumer. Positive reward, routing memory, session affinity, audit, telemetry, and the caller can therefore consume only the detached exact identity even if a provider retains and later mutates its original object. Generic provider execution remains unchanged.

gates.name: campaign-response-snapshot-ruff
gates.command: python3 -m ruff check dharma_swarm/agent_runner.py dharma_swarm/campaign_provider_guard.py tests/test_orchestrator.py tests/test_providers.py

dharmagraph_provides: one exact detached campaign response after provider/model attestation
nested response values isolated before positive-evidence awaits
the same snapshot boundary for routed and direct campaign invocation
organism_provides: typed campaign authority, principal, route lock, and attempt generation
sole-writer control serialization and deployment hold
cross_packet_interface.shared_proof: a provider-retained mutable response cannot change the provider/model identity or nested result observed by campaign positive evidence after exact attestation

interface_mismatches: LLMResponse is mutable and a provider can retain the same object it returns.
ModelRouter awaits success telemetry after initial identity attestation, so an aliased response could previously mutate before affinity, audit, telemetry, and return.
Direct AgentRunner invocation previously returned the provider-owned alias even though no routed telemetry await occurred inside that method.
A schema-valid council review is not served-model attestation and cannot substitute for a real authenticated wire proof.
honest_blockers: The snapshot is a runtime evaluator boundary, not yet a statically parameterized VerifiedResponse[provider, model, request_digest] type.
This proves alias isolation inside the trusted process, not provider authenticity, transport integrity, useful output, independent acceptance, or completion.
A process crash after provider start remains indeterminate and is owned by a separate campaign recovery hardening packet.
Deployment remains held pending a fresh exact child release, authenticated served-identity proof, mobile observer proof, rollback, and Mac-offline drill.
session_entry.rollback: Stop the campaign supervisor and revert this five-path packet. Generic non-campaign routing is unchanged. Campaign dispatch must remain disabled after rollback because an aliased provider response could again mutate after attestation and contaminate positive evidence. Preserve all tasks, runs, claims, receipts, and leases.
